units.positions: m, x horizontal and z positive down

rectangle.source: Harmonica finite prism, strike +/- 10,000 km; independently checked by area quadrature

polygon.source: 96-point Gauss-Legendre area integration per triangle, checked at order 64

polygon_reversed.source: same area integral as polygon, reversed winding

polygon_translated.source: same area integral as polygon, translated with observations

concave.source: sum of independent area integrations over two rectangles

cylinder.source: analytic infinite circular cylinder; 1024-sided inscribed polygon approximation independently checked by area quadrature

slab.source: exact analytic finite-width rectangle; separate infinite-slab limit assertion

relative_error.reason: campaign float32 limit, including geometric truncation

cross_path_relative_error.reason: sum of two independent 1e-4 implementation error budgets

zero_absolute_error_mgal.reason: zero density has exactly zero response
